title: Steve Lewis, Joe Robichaux and Walter Pichon as pianists
summary: Only Steve and Joe influenced him; Steve sang vulgar party songs.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Now, are there any other old time piano players, save that period of Steve Lewis, that you might remember anything characteristic of their style? No, just Steve and Joe.
Because they were the only two of Walter. I never did pay too much attention to his style, of course he was coming along at that

time. Walter Pichon? Yeah. Of course he's made quite a few records, too, so we know how he played pretty well. Steve Lewis made a few records, too, with the band, but you can't hear much of him on those records with P-Roll.
Steve used to play and sing a lot of songs, you know, those party songs that you would call it, you know, people would like to hear that. But he-
I didn't know he sang much. He used to sing that too.
